features:
Key Features:

Bold Roasted Garlic Flavor: Intensely seasoned with roasted garlic, perfect for garlic lovers.

Crispy Rye Chips Only: Special Request version contains only the rye chips from the original snack mix—no pretzels or breadsticks.

Snack-Size Convenience: Available in resealable bags and single-serve packs for easy snacking at home, work, or on the go.

Crafted by Gardetto’s: A trusted name in savory snack mixes, known for quality and bold flavors.

Unique Texture: Double-toasted rye chips deliver a hearty, ultra-crunchy bite that’s satisfying and flavorful.

Benefits:

Flavor-Packed Snacking: Garlic and rye offer a savory, bold taste not found in typical chips or crackers.

Ideal for Entertaining: Great for party bowls, charcuterie boards, or as a crunchy topping for soups and salads.

No Wasted Mix-Ins: Appeals to fans who prefer the rye chips over other pieces in standard snack mixes.

Filling and Satisfying: With a mix of carbs, fat, and a little protein, these chips can hold you over between meals.

Versatile Use: Eat straight from the bag or use as a crunchy garnish for creative meals or bar snacks.
ingredients: Enriched Flour (wheat flour, niacin, iron, riboflavin, thiamin mononitrate, folic acid), Vegetable Oil (high oleic canola, high oleic soybean, high oleic sunflower, palm, fractionated palm, palm olein and/or soybean), Rye Flour, Sugar, Salt. Contains 2% or less of: Yeast, Monosodium Glutamate, Maltodextrin, Dried Worcestershire Sauce (vinegar, molasses, corn syrup, salt, caramel color, garlic powder, sugar, spice, tamarind, natural flavor), Onion Powder, Garlic Powder, Fumaric Acid, Spice, Sodium Diacetate, Disodium Inosinate, Disodium Guanylate, Caramel Color. Freshness Preserved by BHT.
